description: This file defines the LeaveRequestService class within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It manages leave requests, including changing leave statuses, handling workflows, dispatching leave events, and retrieving leave status information. The class incorporates methods for permission checks and grouping leaves by leave request, indicating it is a core service component for managing leave request lifecycle and workflows.

classes.name: LeaveRequestService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing leave requests, including workflow actions, status updates, event dispatching, and retrieval of detailed leave and request information.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the LeaveRequestDao instance used for database interactions related to leave requests.

methods.name: _changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a list of leaves, handles entitlement adjustments, and persists changes via DAO.

methods.name: _notifyLeaveStatusChange
methods.description: Dispatches appropriate events based on the workflow action (approve, cancel, reject).

methods.name: getLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves allowed workflow states for a leave request given employee, leave type, status, and privileges.

methods.name: isLeaveRequestActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is permitted for an employee on a leave request in a certain status.

methods.name: generateIncludeRolesForLeaveWorkflowByEmployee
methods.description: Determines roles to consider for workflow permissions, usually 'ESS' for self-review.

methods.name: generateLeaveStatusByLeaveType
methods.description: Prepends a deleted status prefix if the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestActions
methods.description: Returns available actions for a leave request based on current statuses and workflows.

methods.name: changeLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a detailed leave request, including notifying relevant parties.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Updates a single leave’s status and triggers notifications.

methods.name: changeLeavesStatus
methods.description: Updates multiple leaves’ statuses and dispatches notifications accordingly.

methods.name: groupLeaves
methods.description: Groups leaves by their leave request ID for bulk operations.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Retrieves detailed leave request objects, aggregating leave data.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of leave requests keyed by their ID.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Retrieves a cached associative array of all leave statuses.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Returns the status name for a given status code, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Returns the status code for a given status name, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusesByNames
methods.description: Converts an array of status names into their corresponding codes.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Returns detailed leave objects combining leave and associated leave request data.
